verdict.rationale: Stripe's own docs show built-in background automations a user can turn on: Billing automates recurring payments and renewals, Smart Retries automatically retry failed payments, and revenue-recovery features need no code. These are fixed, product-specific automations rather than a general user-configurable automation builder. Webhooks are developer building blocks and Kyber is a third-party app, so neither earns credit. Missing for 10: a first-party general-purpose automation/workflow builder with user-defined triggers and actions, any evidence of agent-driven autonomous background runs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: It automates recurring payments, creates custom pricing plans, and handles billing periods, such as trials and renewals.
Smart Retries: Automatically retry failed payments to prevent involuntary churn due to temporary issues.
None of the features require you to write code.
